_comment: EXAMPLE exercise library for the daily noon suggestion job (scripts/daily-exercise-suggestion.py). The real library is private user data at $MINERU_BRIEFS_ROOT/briefs_exercise/exercises.json. Each day the job walks a window of 3 over rotation_order and picks one exercise per featured group (day ordinal modulo group size). Every group in rotation_order needs at least one exercise. Optional per exercise: source, source_reel + start_s/end_s + crop_top (for scripts/exercise_frame_select.py) and frames (3 paths relative to the briefs root) for the collage; an exercise without frames is still delivered as text. library_note is an optional footer line.

exercises.name: Wall Angels
exercises.how: Back flat on a wall, slide the arms up and down like a slow snow angel.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.how: On your back, lower the opposite arm and leg while the low back stays pressed down.
